title.en: MIT’s weather breakthrough learns from mistakes. Can it buy us two weeks?
title.zh: MIT让天气预报学会改错，能否多争取两周？

summary.en: An add-on improves probabilistic forecasts in the two-to-six-week window. Better preparation is a possibility; guaranteed local predictions are not.
summary.zh: 一层纠错工具改善两至六周概率预报。提前准备更有希望，但不保证某地某日准确。

title.en: Microsoft signed for 20 years of power. Who gets the promised $140?
title.zh: 微软签下二十年电力，承诺的140美元能落到谁家？

summary.en: NiSource says Microsoft funds its required infrastructure, with service expected in 2028. Projected household savings are not money already delivered.
summary.zh: NiSource称微软负担所需设施，预计2028年供电。家庭节省仍是预测，尚未兑现。
